note: Vernon County park near Viroqua around a 38-acre flood-control lake, with trout streams, a boat launch and about 10 miles of hiking and mountain-bike trails. Three separate camping areas: the main area on County Road XX (several electric sites, 214-218, sit on open grass by Coe Hollow Creek), Upper Ridge on Campsite Road (wooded ridge) and Boat Landing on Boat Landing Road (most full-hookup sites). Most of the 35 rustic sites are under 23 ft. --Claude
summary: County page, 2026 rates PDF and detailed map read (+ the 2026-10-13 Campspot capture): $30 electric / $40 E+W / $55 full hookups (rustic $20, mostly under 23 ft) + $8 fee; 2-night minimum on advance bookings, online closes 3 days out, Wednesday FCFS for the weekend; Apr 15 - Oct 15; 85 sites (stored 74), RV types to 40 ft. Lakeview -> not waterfront (no site sees the lake). Three areas with separate entrances - Boat Landing is ~1.3 km from the main area (split candidate).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview (sweep value, no --AWH) -> not waterfront. No camping area sees the 38-acre lake on Esri imagery: the main area's sites end ~280 m north of the lake's head, beyond the day-use parking lot, shelter and playground (pin 43.5451,-90.9604 is that lot); Upper Ridge (~43.5412,-90.9647) is ~350 m west of the lake on a wooded ridge under continuous canopy; Boat Landing (~43.5381,-90.9497) sits on Sidie Hollow Creek ~140-200 m upstream of the lake's east arm behind trees and marsh.

WATERFRONT LEAD (creekside): main-area electric sites 214-218 (east of County Road XX, around 43.5464,-90.9603) stand on open mown grass ~20-30 m from Coe Hollow Creek, a ~2-3 m trout stream, with no road between (Esri hw 130 m at 43.5470,-90.9600; campers visible on the pads). Sites 209-213 are also between the road and the creek but partly under trees. These are nightly electric sites ($30). Reviewer's call between creekside (with a caveat naming 214-218) and not waterfront.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: three areas with their own roads and addresses, one Campspot listing (https://www.campspot.com/book/sidie-hollow-park). Main Campground Area, E6051 County Road XX, sites 201-230 (30), centroid ~43.5468,-90.9603 (dump, showers, office); Upper Ridge Campground, S5001 Campsite Road, sites 301-330 (30; mostly electric and electric+water), centroid ~43.5412,-90.9647; Boat Landing Campground, S5184 Boat Landing Road, sites 101-125 (25; 106-122 full hookups, 123-125 electric+water, 101-105 rustic; camp host at site 9 per the county page - likely site 109), centroid ~43.5381,-90.9497. Measured: main-Boat Landing ~1.3 km, Upper Ridge-Boat Landing ~1.26 km, main-Upper Ridge ~0.72 km. Boat Landing clears the ~1 km line; Upper Ridge does not (straight-line), though it has its own road.

SITES: stored 74 (note prose) -> 85 (county page; map numbers 101-125, 201-230, 301-330; Campspot 17+15+18+35). Campspot's 35 primitive sites run to 30 ft but only 1 takes 23 ft+; the 50 electric/full-hookup sites take up to 40 ft.
MIN STAY: 2 nights on every advance reservation (county page) - a 2-night rule, not a drop candidate; walk-ups from Wednesday for the weekend.

PIN: stored 43.5451,-90.9604 is the main area's day-use parking lot, ~190 m south of the main loop centroid ~43.5468,-90.9603; no move proposed (if split, Boat Landing gets ~43.5381,-90.9497, which is where Campspot pins the park).
SEASONAL: the county offers a $2,000 full-season rate on full-hookup sites (18 sites); every site type is also sold nightly on Campspot. Not a long-stay park.
